<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/freight/{reference}/deviation"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Register a deviation (e.g. damaged goods, a failed pickup) on an existing order identified by its
Swipload reference. The calling company must be the shipper or the carrier on the order, and the
deviation is attributed to the user the `api-token` resolves to.

`DeviationMoment` is optional and is recorded as sent — it is not checked against the order's
status. When it is omitted the moment is derived from that status instead: `Deliver` for an
order that is `InTransit` or `Delivered`, `PickUp` for any earlier status. Either
way the moment that was recorded is returned in the response.
A deviation cannot be registered on an order that is `Draft`, `Cancelled` or
`Deleted`.
A supporting document is optional and may be supplied inline as `DocumentData` or by link as
`DocumentURL`, but never both. A `DocumentURL` that cannot be downloaded does not fail
the request: the deviation is registered and the response reports `DocumentUploaded` as false
with the reason in `DocumentError`.
